text:
maya: Heads up — we need to lock down the SLO/dashboard contract for per-model/route metrics: P50/P95/P99, TTFT (time-to-first-token), and tokens/sec. Console wants concrete metric names/labels + sampling guidance so we can wire panels without blowing up Prometheus costs. Who can own the runtime-side schema?

dan: We can own the runtime side. Proposal: emit the following primitives from runtime (Prometheus style):
- ttft_bucket (histogram) and ttft_sum/ttft_count
- request_duration_bucket / _sum / _count
- tokens_count_total (counter)
- requests_total (counter)
- tokens_in_flight / tokens_per_sec (gauge, optional)
Labels: model_id, model_variant, route, customer_tier, hw_type, quantized, seq_len_bucket (short/med/long), region
Notes: avoid free-form route params (no user IDs) to limit cardinality.

ravi: Quick question — will runtime emit full buckets for every request? cardinality still scary if model_id+route+variant explode. We should formalize sampling policy and a sampled_count metric.

dan: Agreed. Runtime will emit full histogram buckets only when sampled=true. We'll add metric: metric_sampled_total{model_id,route,...} and label sample_rate (e.g., "1e-2"). Default plan: hosted API -> sample 1% (configurable by route), dedicated -> 100%.

sophie: UX requirements: Console panels need to show: current P50/P95/P99, historical trend (1h/6h/7d), and compare model_variant rollouts (canary vs baseline). We also need TTFT median + tail and tokens/sec (throughput) per route. Also a toggle to switch between raw and downsampled view.

oliver: From SRE side — cost/ops notes:
- Estimate: hosted 20k req/s peak, full hist buckets for all labels at 1% sampling should be fine. 100% would be untenable.
- Ingest path: metrics -> push through metrics-ingest (kafka topic `slo-metrics`) -> metrics-aggregator -> prometheus/tsdb with rollups.
- Retention: keep high-cardinality raw for 7d, 1m rollups for 90d.

maya: Dan/ravi — can you paste example PromQLs the Console team can use for panel wiring? P95 TTFT and tokens/sec per route.

dan: Sure, rough PromQL examples (we'll refine):
```
# P95 TTFT per model+route (sampled histograms)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_id, route))
```
```
# tokens/sec per model+route (from counters)
sum by (model_id, route) (rate(tokens_count_total[1m]))
```
```
# normalized tokens/sec per request (throughput)
sum by (model_id, route) (rate(tokens_count_total[1m])) / sum by (model_id, route) (rate(requests_total[1m]))
```
Add `customer_tier` and `model_variant` to `by(...)` in panels when needed.

ravi: For console SLO math, we should expose precomputed P95/P99 as derived metrics to avoid expensive histogram_quantile over many label combinations. Runtime can emit aggregated p95_aprox{model_id,route,window="5m"} computed in aggregator. That will save queries. Thoughts?

dan: We can do that in the aggregator: compute quantiles using TDigest or HDR histograms per sharded window and emit `ttft_p95` / `ttft_p99` metrics as gauges. Downside: introduces slight lag (windowed), but good tradeoff.

sophie: That lag is fine if it's documented. UX will show "last computed at". Also need a way to compare variants side-by-side — suggest a panel with multi-select for model_variant and a rollout_tag label.

oliver: Actionable constraints for infra teams:
- runtime: add sampled=true metric, sample_rate label, and emit histogram buckets only when sampled=true.
- aggregator: compute and emit pre-aggregated p50/p95/p99 and 1m/5m rollups to reduce query cost.
- ingest: set up kafka topic `slo-metrics` and schema (proto) for metric events.
- console: wire up panels to prefer precomputed gauges when available, fallback to histogram_quantile otherwise.

maya: timeline & owners?

dan: runtime schema + sampling flags: PR by EOD Fri, tests next week. owner: dan (eng-runtime).

ravi: aggregator work + proto schema: I'll draft proto by Tue. owner: ravi (eng-platform).

sophie: Console wiring + ux: Sophie + product designer will sketch panels Wed, then implement next sprint.

oliver: Ingest/kafka + retention policy: I'll file infra ticket. owner: oliver (eng-sre).

maya: Perfect. I'll create a cross-team RFC with the contract (metrics names, labels, sample defaults, rollup windows). Please drop links and PRs here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployed metrics-ingest schema v0.1 -> staging (link: https://deploys.redwood/example/metrics-ingest/v0.1)

maya: Thanks — next check-in here on Monday. If anyone has alternatives to 1% hosted sampling, propose now.

dan: We can make sample_rate by-route and dynamic (based on qps thresholds). Might be useful for very hot routes.

ravi: Noted — we'll add `config.sample_rate` per-route in routing service config.

maya: OK closing for now, will update RFC with these notes.
